title: Spec Feature Coverage Report Schema
description: Output of compute_feature_coverage.py — cross-references a feature-manifest against the actual src/python/<fmt>/ implementation via static AST analysis. This is the artifact Gate 9 requires: implementation_authorized may only be true when gate_9_eligible is true here.

manifest_ref.description: Path to the feature-manifest.json this report was computed against.

manifest_hash.description: SHA-256 of the manifest file at computation time, so a stale report can be detected if the manifest changes later.

missing_unreasoned.description: MISSING or PARTIAL items with no deferred_reason set. Must be 0 for gate_9_eligible.

evidence.description: file:function/class evidence found by the static scanner, or 'not found' for MISSING.

deferred_reason.description: Required (non-null) when status is PARTIAL or MISSING and the gap is a conscious scope decision rather than an open defect.
